meta.title: Kotoriyama Ski Area
meta.description: Rope-tow gentle slopes with a private, crowd-free feel—pair first snow play with Terume Hakuryo onsen and Oe town dining in one Yamagata local day.

hero.title:
Kotoriyama
Ski Area
hero.tagline: Experience a private local snow resort perfect for beginners, paired with premium hot springs in Yamagata.

transit.title:
From Shinjo into Oe—
a local snow-play hill.
transit.lead: Drive from JR Shinjo Station toward Oe town on the Yamagata Shinkansen line—signage can be tricky in winter, so check official detour maps and map pin locations before you go. Once you arrive, enjoy uncrowded snow debut and sled play at Kotoriyama.
specs: ~40 min by car from Shinjo Station
transit.imgAlt: Snow-country road toward Kotoriyama Ski Area in Oe, Yamagata

primary.title: Private feel × standout value
primary.lead: Smaller than nearby major hills—but "no one watching when you wipe out" privacy and low prices are the draw. Ideal for beginners and families making their snow debut.
primary.imgAlt: Uncrowded Kotoriyama slopes—gentle snow field and rope tow

secondary.title: Rope-tow-only peace of mind
secondary.lead: No chairlifts, mostly surface tows—less fear on steep terrain, highly rated for teaching kids their first turns. Lower collision risk reassures families.

pass.title:
Small hill,
big value.
pass.lead: Short runs won't satisfy advanced skiers—but low day-ticket prices and no crowds make it perfect for first snow play or sled-only days.
pass.noticeBody: Show your rope-tow ticket for Terume Hakuryo bath discounts and road-station perks—reach nearby families via #PrivateGelende #FirstSnowPlay.
pass.imgAlt: Value-focused day trip—Kotoriyama and Oe town loop

rental.title:
Travel light,
play in the snow.
rental.lead: Few full ski shops in Oe town—proposed hub linking large sports stores in Sagae, Tendo, and Yamagata City plus lodgings for advance rental and on-site delivery.
rental.whisper: Enable hands-free snow play by coordinating rental inventory across the area.
rental.imgAlt: Family starting snow play with rental gear—hub delivery concept

spa.title:
After runs,
Funauta onsen in 5 min.
spa.lead: Terume Hakuryo Health Spa ~3 km away (~5 min by car)—high dissolved-mineral content; water shifts through six hues from emerald to milky white. Sauna plus Restaurant Kawakaze for Yamagata beef and local chicken.
spa.whisper: Adjacent to Michi-no-Eki Oe Koramagase (2024 renewal)—weekly lunch specials pair well with the loop.
spa.imgAlt: Terume Hakuryo high-mineral onsen—Oe town spa after snow play

family.title:
First snow,
without the pressure.
family.lead: Gentle pitch ideal for beginners—reviews praise it for kids and as "the best place to teach your first ski lesson." Rope tows need arm strength; younger kids may prefer the sled zone.
family.noticeBody: Signage can be hard to spot and nav apps may misroute—check official winter detour maps and map pin locations before you go.
family.imgAlt: Sledding and first runs—uncrowded family zone at Kotoriyama

workation.title:
Oe local
one-day loop.
workation.lead: Kotoriyama alone makes for a short stay—bundle Terume Hakuryo, the road station, and Tazawamori Castle Ruins Park for a full day in Oe town.

05.body: Yamagata beef and local chicken dinner in Oe

local.title: Private hill × Oe town loop guide
local.body: Pair snow play with onsen in one day—Kotoriyama's low prices, uncrowded slopes, and rope-tow focus fit families making their first turns.

schools.title: Snow + onsen cross-promotion
schools.body: Tow ticket holders get Terume Hakuryo bath discounts and road-station perks—#PrivateGelende #FirstSnowPlay for nearby families.

summer.title: Private Snow Playground
summer.body: Not for hardcore skiers—for families wanting everyday Japanese snow-country life or overseas visitors seeking a private playground culture—position as a family niche.
